beats.say: Anthropic has priced its initial public offering. The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19.
The offering consists of 980,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, 956,351,354 of which are being sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 of which are being sold by certain selling stockholders.
LLC, Attention: Prospectus Department, 200 West Street, New York, NY 10282, by telephone at 471-2526, or by email at prospectus-nyny.email.gs.com; or Morgan Stanley & Co.
